# enable_ton_wallet_backup()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.enable_ton_wallet_backup`

## Signature

```python
async def enable_ton_wallet_backup(encrypted_parts: List[bytes], proof: Optional['types.TonWalletOwnershipProof'] = None) -> 'types.TonWalletState': ...
```

## Documentation

Enable the backup of the key of the TON wallet of the current user.

Works only if [`TonWalletState`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletState.md) *can_enable_backup* is True.

> [!WARNING]
> The backup contains the secret phrase of the wallet, which gives full control over its funds.
> Pyrogram doesn't implement the encryption of the backup, the parts must be produced by your own code.
> TDLib (`TonWalletManager::enable_ton_wallet_backup`) pads the secret phrase with spaces to 215 bytes and
> splits it into three random parts whose XOR is the padded phrase. Each part is prefixed with
> `b"\x08\xdd\x90\x8b\xd7"` and encrypted with tde2e `encrypt_message_for_one`, using the key shared
> (ECDH) between a new temporary private key and the public key of one of the data centers returned by
> for 288 bytes in total.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`encrypted_parts`** (List of `bytes`)
  The encrypted parts of the secret phrase, one for each data center returned by
  [`get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs`](get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs.md), in the same order.

- **`proof`** ([`TonWalletOwnershipProof`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletOwnershipProof.md), *optional*)
  Proof of the ownership of the wallet. Use
  [`get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge`](get_ton_wallet_ownership_proof_challenge.md) to get a challenge for the proof.
  TDLib always sends it.

### Returns

[`TonWalletState`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletState.md): On success, the new state of the wallet is returned.

### Example

```python
dcs = await app.get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs()
# parts and proof are computed by your own wallet code
state = await app.enable_ton_wallet_backup(parts, proof)
```
